what: A7 source ownership. Exactly one class per path. Generators may write only 'derived' paths; 'authoritative' and 'inherited' paths are refused by scripts/native_gate/authority.py.

classes.authoritative: Hand-edited source of truth. No generator writes it. The native gate proves it byte-identical across normal regeneration.
classes.authored: Hand-written reviewed records (expectations, role maps, authorized deltas, rationale). Changing one needs review.
classes.derived: Written only by a named generator from authoritative/authored inputs; --check must report it current.
classes.inherited: Immutable A5 checkpoint, referenced by path and SHA-256; never copied over, edited or regenerated.
classes.fixture: Test infrastructure under scripts/tests/fixtures/native/; never an A7 board.

entries.rule: byte-for-byte; scripts/verify_seed.py must PASS before and after every gate run

Authoritative routed A7 controller board (R4, #19). Source of truth (independent layout/electrical review on PR #30, head e2a2219); no generator writes it. Seeded by scripts/a7_board.py build + scripts/a7_route.py + a7_board.py apply in an empty staging dir outside the repo, then copied here once native DRC (0 violations, 0 unconnected) and parity passed. Enforced by native_gate.json with candidate a7_controller.

Derived from the immutable A5 design data plus the A7 changes in scripts/a7_electronics.py (J1, J2, SW1 only). Never hand-edited; --check must report it current. The A5 writer port is proven by a7_electronics.py reproduce-a5 (byte-identical A5 schematic).
Stricter-only custom DRC rules recorded in native_gate.json design_rule_delta.custom_rules; the gate refuses a file that differs from the profile and a control proves KiCad applies it.
PJ324M and PCM13SMTR only; every dimension tagged MIRROR/ASSUMED/INFERRED in footprint_sources.json. A5 footprints are referenced read-only from engineering/a5.

Placement input for the R4 staging board, checked against R2's placement-envelopes.json keep-outs (courtyard, side and keep-out rules). The routed board, once it lands, is the authority for positions; this file only records how it was seeded.

entries.generator: python3 scripts/native_gate/authority.py export-placement (from fresh native facts of the authoritative board)
entries.rule: Placement/connectivity export for the mechanical model (R2); records the board SHA-256. The gate's regeneration step re-checks it.

entries.generator: python3 scripts/a7_schematic_check.py --out <empty dir outside the repo> --evidence-dir engineering/a7/verification/schematic
entries.rule: Fresh pinned-image ERC, netlist, staging parity, interface and delta results of the committed schematic. Evidence of a run, not a board result.
A7 revision gate profile; candidate a7_controller (the authoritative routed board). Any rule delta is recorded in design_rule_delta with fabricator evidence.
every schematic delta vs the A5 baseline netlist, each with reason, issue and review
pin identities for the behavioral assertions; new jack/switch pins come from exact-part evidence (R1, #16)
fixture boards are regenerated only with scripts/native_gate/make_fixture.py into an empty directory, then reviewed and committed
fabricator capability rows quoted with URL and retrieval hash; backs native_gate.json design_rule_delta

Router proposal (python3 -I scripts/a7_route.py --seed 0 --geometry <a7_board.py build geometry.json>) that seeded the authoritative board; reproduces byte-identically from the current placement. A record only: the board, not this file, is the source of truth, and nothing regenerates the board from it.

regeneration_rules: Normal generation never writes an authoritative board; the gate hashes it before and after its regeneration --check.
Placement/connectivity for downstream geometry is exported from fresh native facts of the authoritative board (scripts/native_gate/authority.py export-placement) and records the board SHA-256.
Initial-board generation writes only into an empty directory outside the repository (authority.py init-board, make_fixture.py).
The A7 schematic is derived (scripts/a7_electronics.py), declared above; the board remains the only authoritative A7 electronics file.
